summary: Implemented and independently certified the additive resolution-v2 N-product conflict review preview and durable paged draft receipts while preserving the legacy selected-pair workflow.
changes: Added a strict resolution-v2 preview parser for up to 1600 reviewed merge groups and 4000 distinct products; nonempty Remove and v2 Apply fail closed as phase_not_available.
Canonicalized exact duplicate groups, coalesced overlap only when the full union shares one nonempty normalized name or barcode, and blocked transitive or incomplete identity.
Froze original-group distinct-positive cost means, selling and wholesale maxima, source-field options, branch stock, lots, supplier and received-date metadata into per-group state digests.
Added migration 0138 with actor/idempotency-scoped review receipts plus canonical group and member receipts.
Added actor-scoped cursor paging on the persisted draft while leaving legacy {cases} preview/apply parsing and responses intact.

evidence.claim: A global review covers more than 1600 selected products within D1 limits.
evidence.observed: 1604 selected ids across 802 requested groups produced 801 actionable and one stale blocked group; the suite observed 177 statements across success, replay and injected rollback, at most 80 bindings and one compound term.

evidence.claim: Group economics use the immutable original member set.
evidence.observed: Repeated nonzero costs are de-duplicated, zero is excluded, [0,4,4,6] resolves to 5, and retail and wholesale fields use their independent maxima.

evidence.claim: Supplier and receipt metadata remain in the frozen review.
evidence.observed: Separate LOT-A/Supplier A/2026-09-01 and LOT-B/Supplier B/2026-09-02 rows are returned unchanged with the group projection.

evidence.claim: Receipt creation is atomic and product data remains untouched.
evidence.observed: A forced failure at the end of the receipt batch rolled back the review and all group rows; successful preview left product, stock, batch, audit and history counts unchanged.

evidence.claim: Native D1 accepts the actual route SQL.
evidence.observed: Twelve three-member groups completed on native D1 with nine observed route statements, 36 bindings maximum and one compound term.

evidence.claim: The repaired identity predicate requires every member to share the common nonempty key.
evidence.observed: Independent Tea/tea/blank and 601/0601/blank probes both returned incompatible_group_identity; all focused and legacy checks passed.

verification.scope: parser, canonicalization, identity, economics, options and projections
real SQLite route mutation, paging, actor scope, replay, rollback and limits
verification.expected: Review receipts are correct, atomic and bounded.
verification.observed: 34 checks passed; 177 statements, 80 bindings and one compound term.

verification.scope: native Miniflare D1 adapter and migration
verification.expected: N-group review succeeds under native D1.
verification.observed: 12 groups and 36 members passed; 9 statements, 36 bindings and one compound term.

verification.scope: full migration chain, integrity, FKs and LF formatting
verification.expected: Migration 0138 applies in the full chain and stays LF-only.
verification.observed: Eight fresh-chain assertions passed; all 137 migrations are LF.

risks: The frozen group detail can be large for products with many receipt lots; phase-two execution must keep pagination and D1 response limits explicit.
New 0138 tables still need backup, restore, reset and core-data enumeration before any deployment.
not_done: Finalize, destructive N-member apply, composite group Undo/Redo and direct Remove are separate required F65 slices.
No frontend source, backup/reset/core list, production data, remote migration, deployment or remote service was changed.
handoff: Integrate the four phase-one code commits through e2f5489b. Phase two may build from that exact SHA after its architecture review; keep resolution-v2 Apply and Remove disabled until their independently verified implementations land.
